PHASE_2_FROZEN.description: IR identity frozen. Structural changes to protected surface prohibited without governance protocol.

REBASELINE_ACCEPTED.description: Rebaseline approved. Governance has authorized structural evolution.

PHASE_3_DUAL.description: Dual implementation active. Old and new implementations coexist.

INVALID.description: Canonical state cannot be determined. Axiom A3 violation: |C(O)| != 1.
